newsitem.title: ROMANIA: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.
newsitem.headline: RADIO ROMANIA AFTERNOON HEADLINES AT 4 PM.

text.p: * Prime Minister Victor Ciorbea will announce next Monday the reforms and social protection measures, state radio said.
* Romania's government holds talks with trade unions on social protections measures.
* The government will brief parliament on Monday on its package of social protections measures, upper Senate chairman Petre Roman told a news conference.

The government would submit up 80 bills to parliament for approval, he said. A major share of new credits which Bucharest seeks from international lenders is tied to bringing domestic laws in line with international standards, Roman added.
* The lower chamber of Deputies adopted a new traffic code.
* Romania's President Emil Constantinescu met a group of U.S. businessmen who intend to invest in Romania.
